//: Gzipped ceilings for every published bundle, in bytes. Read by scripts/check-size.mjs in CI. Raising a number is a deliberate edit with a reason in the commit message, not silent drift. The core ceiling is set so the documented '~10kb' stays true: 10600 bytes is 10.4KB, which rounds to 10; past 10751 the claim needs rewording, not just a bigger budget. Raised from 9600 (under '~9kb') when error diagnostics landed and crossed that line on its own, then from 10400 to 10600 when four bug fixes together came to 10406, leaving room for the queued devtools plugins view (+132). Headroom is a few percent by design — enough that ordinary work does not trip it, tight enough that a real feature is a conversation.
//plugins: morph raised from 1400 to 1450, and the combined plugins bundle from 4400 to 4450, when morph learned to release scope roots it removes outside every mounted scope (ISSUE-0032): about 40 bytes, and the alternative was leaking effects, listeners and devtools entries.
//devtools: The devtools ceiling is looser than the others on purpose. This bundle is development-only and never loads in production, so its bytes cost a visitor nothing — and the panel's usability is the entire reason it exists. Raised from 5600 to 6000 when docking landed, from 6000 to 6500 when state search and a collapsible scope tree landed, from 6500 to 6800 for per-mode resize handles, and from 6800 to 7200 for the plugins view, to leave room for the panel to keep improving rather than making every UI change a budget negotiation.
